title: 第二十一章 一刀立威第二十二章 刀上带血
lines: 傅游艺下了决心，周柔本是没多大主意的人，再加上县衙外面，合宫县的百姓越集越多，王瞎子外面击鼓鸣冤，大家对事情的前因后果都搞清楚了，形势可以说是群情激昂。
合宫县的百姓才不管武攸敏究竟是什么来头呢！百姓自有一杆秤，来自东都洛阳的豪门纨绔在合宫县的地盘上抢人妻子，胡作非为，这事儿苦主现在告到衙门了，衙门里的官敢不敢管？倘若县衙不敢管，百姓们倒要问问，这些当官的吃了皇粮，究竟能干啥事儿。
周柔人在大堂上，看到这种阵仗吓得浑身冒汗，他一听到傅游艺喊抓人，真是如释重负，哪里还管这事儿会有什么后果？
抓人！岳峰作为文吏亲自带队，率领的一帮人中也有好几名文吏，关键时候，三班衙役里面的燕二这一帮人不敢信任，岳峰亲自出马把握更大一些。
岳峰得了令，县衙里面立刻掀起了极大的波澜，另一旁三班那边，县尉魏生明正猫在廨舍里面观动静呢！他算定了周柔和傅游艺两人没有胆识，绝对不敢轻举妄动。
在他看来，他布下的这个局可以说是天衣无缝，因为不管傅游艺和周柔两人怎么办，他都有后招。
傅游艺和周柔两人不敢抓人，合宫县百姓从此为认定两人昏庸无能，魏生明挺身而出，立刻可以扭转局面。
下意识，魏生明就觉得只有这种可能性，因为抓人在他看来就是自寻死路。别说是傅游艺两人，就算让他去抓人，他也未必敢呢！
当今的天下，最强的豪门便是武氏，京城中有好多因为得罪武氏而被满门下狱的案例，其中甚至还有宰相一级的高官。
现在的形势，天后登基，武氏更不能有丝毫的被冒犯，武攸敏的案子岂能轻易的动粗？
可是结果让他大跌眼镜，燕二急匆匆的赶到他廨舍告诉他消息的时候，他惊得眼珠子都快要从眼眶里面滚出来了：“这……这……他……他……说什么？抓人？”
燕二道：“不错，就是抓人，周柔在堂上钦点了岳峰为首领，岳峰刚刚来捕班带走了十几名捕快，一行人浩浩汤汤直奔绣春坊去了！”
魏生明怔立当场，一句话也说不出来，过了好大一会儿，他才道：“好哇，这姓傅的我还真小瞧了他！他有胆！不过这简直是自寻死路，武公子是何等身份，这个案子必然要惹出大祸来，我倒要看看就凭他们两人，能不能兜得住！”
魏生明咬牙切齿，燕二却一脸的委屈道：“魏大人，绣春坊那边的安排可都是我亲手办的！你说回头会不会牵连到我身上。再说了，武公子来合宫县受了这么大的委屈，必然心情大坏，回头他必然责怪我没能好好安排，大人恐怕也不能全身而退呢！”
魏生明脸色瞬间阴沉下来，道：“事情到了这一步，傅游艺都不怕，我们还怕什么？不是我小瞧傅游艺，就凭他的几号人，还不一定能抓到人呢！”
魏生明怀疑岳峰的能力，果然，岳峰率领人马赶到绣春坊，武攸敏正率领自己的一帮走狗大肆作乐呢！
听说县衙来人抓他，他差点笑破肚皮，道：“老子武攸敏到这里一游，没去找他们县衙的麻烦，他们几个当官的就该烧高香了，嘿，他们还敢惹我？我看他们是活得不耐烦了，孩儿们，你们愣着干什么？还不把这帮不知天高地厚的家伙给轰出去？”
武攸敏微醺醉意，嚣张跋扈到了极点，他一声喊，他的一帮护卫随从一个个都抄上了家伙，竟然和县衙的捕快们对抗！
县衙里面的一帮捕快心中也都虚着呢！竟然被这阵势给镇住了，好在岳峰领头，他大喝一声，道：“我们手持衙门的令箭，乃官差抓嫌犯，敢拘捕者，可以当场格杀！”
岳峰说完，抽出了腰刀，一刀劈向了一名武氏护卫，这一刀下去，血光冲天，那股血腥味道弥漫开来，酒肆里面的众多护卫哪里还敢嚣张，气焰瞬间为岳峰所夺！
岳峰一马当先，冲到了武攸敏的面前，喝道：“敢问你可是武攸敏？”
武攸敏盯着岳峰，看着岳峰手中明晃晃带着血迹的刀，喉结下意识的蠕动了一下，咽了一口唾沫，道：“壮……壮士，误会，绝对误会了！”
岳峰冷冷的扫了他一眼，一摆手，道：“给我抓起来，戴上手脚镣铐，押入大牢！”
岳峰一声令下，众捕快哪里敢违背？当即上前把武攸敏给抓住，武攸敏哪里受过这等委屈，当即喊道：
“放肆，你们放肆？你们可知道我是什么身份，我乃天后之从侄，你们这么做是欲要造反耶？”
岳峰不管他叫喊，抓了人，他立刻在酒肆后面的院子里寻找强子等几人的踪迹，强子三人被打伤之后，都关在柴房里面，岳峰一脚把柴房的门踢开，强子一眼看到了岳峰，瞪大了眼睛，怔怔好大一会儿说不出话来！
“怎么了？不认得我的吗？走吧，姓武的那小子被我抓了！”岳峰笑道。
“啊……”强子倒吸了一口凉气，他上前一步想要说话，眼眶却先泛红，他“噗通”一声跪在地上，道：“我……我连累首领了……”
他这一句话说完，整个人像小孩子一般哭起来。他做梦都没想到岳峰竟然会来救他。两人之间的交情说起并不深，强子捅的篓子又实在太大，谁都兜不住，可是……
岳峰嘴角微微翘起，眼睛扫了一眼另外两人，道：“别废话了！不是嫂夫人被抓了么？还不快去找人去？”
岳峰这话一说，强子浑身一震，冲着岳峰再叩一头，冲了出去。
岳峰从后院走出来，这时候绣春坊已经被围得水泄不通，县城里但凡听闻消息的百姓，几乎都往这边敢。
岳峰抱拳看向众人道：“奉县衙傅主薄、周县丞之命抓捕强抢民女的暴徒武攸敏，各位父老乡亲还请行个方便！”
岳峰这话一说，人群立马响起雷鸣般的喝彩声，有人喊道：“抓得好，傅主薄和周县丞果然是大清官！”
“岳壮士也是大好人，是我们合宫县的真勇士！”
人群在喊，鲁小山从后面挤过来凑到岳峰耳边道：“首领，强子没有找到嫂子，应该是姓武的有随从脚底抹油，把人给带走了……”
content_en:
Fu Youyi made up her mind. Zhou Rou didn't have much idea at first. In addition, more and more people from Hegong County gathered outside the county government office. Blind Wang beat drums outside to complain. Everyone understood the cause and effect of the matter. The situation could be said to be passionate.
The people of Hegong County don't care who Wu Youmin is! The common people have their own scale. A wealthy dandy from Luoyang, the eastern capital, is robbing someone's wife on the land of Hegong County and doing whatever they want. Now the owner of the matter has brought this matter to the Yamen. Do the officials in the Yamen dare to intervene? If the county government doesn't dare to take care of it, the people have to ask what can these officials do if they eat the royal food.
Zhou Rouren was so frightened that he was sweating when he saw this kind of battle in the lobby. When he heard Fu Youyi calling for arrest, he was so relieved. How could he care about the consequences of this?
Arrest people! As a civil servant, Yue Feng personally led the team, and there were several civil servants among the group he led. At the critical moment, Yan Er and the others in the third class of yamen did not dare to trust them, so Yue Feng was more confident in taking action personally.
After Yue Feng got the order, a huge commotion immediately arose in the county government office. On the other side of Class 3, County Lieutenant Wei Shengming was watching the action in the mansion! He calculated that Zhou Rou and Fu Youyi had no courage and would never dare to act rashly.
In his opinion, the game he set up was perfect, because no matter what Fu Youyi and Zhou Rou did, he had a backup plan.
Fu Youyi and Zhou Rou did not dare to arrest anyone. From then on, the people of Hegong County believed that the two were incompetent. Wei Shengming stepped forward and could immediately reverse the situation.
Subconsciously, Wei Shengming felt that this was the only possibility, because arresting people seemed to him to be seeking death. Let alone Fu Youyi, even if he was asked to arrest people, he might not dare to do it!
In today's world, the most powerful wealthy family is the Wu family. There are many cases in the capital where people have been imprisoned for offending the Wu family, including even high-ranking officials at the prime minister level.
In the current situation, the Queen has ascended the throne, and the Wu family cannot be offended in the slightest. How can violence be easily used in Wu Youmin's case?
But the result shocked him. When Yan Er hurried to his house to tell him the news, he was so shocked that his eyes nearly rolled out of his sockets: "This...this...he...he...what did he say? Arrest someone?"
Yan Er said: "Yes, they are arresting people. Zhou Rou appointed Yue Feng as the leader in the hall. Yue Feng just came to the arrest team and took away more than a dozen arrests. The whole group went straight to Xiuchunfang!"
Wei Shengming stood stunned on the spot and couldn't say a word. After a long while, he said: "Okay, I really underestimated this guy named Fu! He is brave! But this is simply asking for death. With Mr. Wu's status, this case is bound to cause a big disaster. I want to see if the two of them can survive it!"
Wei Shengming gritted his teeth, but Yan Er said with an aggrieved look on his face: "Master Wei, the arrangements at Xiuchunfang were all made by me! Do you think it will implicate me later? Besides, Mr. Wu must be in a bad mood when he came to Hegong County and suffered such a great grievance. When he comes back, he will definitely blame me for not making good arrangements. I'm afraid I won't be able to escape unscathed!"
Wei Shengming's face suddenly darkened and he said: "Fu Youyi is not afraid of things when things have come to this point, so what are we afraid of? It's not that I underestimate Fu Youyi, but just based on how many people he has, he may not be able to catch anyone!"
Wei Shengming doubted Yue Feng's ability. Sure enough, Yue Feng led his troops to Xiuchunfang, and Wu Youmin was leading a group of his lackeys to have fun!
Hearing that people from the county government came to arrest him, he almost burst into laughter and said: "I, Wu Youmin, came here and didn't go to trouble the county government. Those officials should be burning incense. Hey, they still dare to mess with me? I think they are impatient. Children, what are you doing standing around? Why don't you kick out these guys who don't know the heights of the world?"
Wu Youmin was slightly tipsy and extremely arrogant. When he shouted, his group of guards and followers all picked up the guy one by one, and actually fought against the county government agents!
A bunch of policemen in the county government are also feeling guilty! He was actually overwhelmed by this formation. Fortunately, Yue Feng took the lead. He shouted loudly and said: "We are armed with the command arrows of the Yamen. We are officers to catch the suspects. Anyone who dares to arrest can be killed on the spot!"
After Yue Feng finished speaking, he drew out his waist knife and struck a Wu clan guard with one blow. When the knife went down, blood shot into the sky, and the smell of blood filled the air. How could the many guards in the wine shop dare to be so arrogant? Yue Feng instantly captured their arrogance!
Yue Feng took the lead and rushed in front of Wu Youmin, shouting: "Are you Wu Youmin?"
Wu Youmin stared at Yue Feng, looking at the blood-stained knife in Yue Feng's hand. His Adam's apple squirmed subconsciously, and he swallowed and said: "Zhuang...Zhuang, I misunderstood, absolutely misunderstood!"
Yue Feng glanced at him coldly, waved his hand, and said: "Catch him, shackle his hands and feet, and put him in prison!"
Yue Feng gave an order, how dare the policemen disobey it? He immediately stepped forward and caught Wu Youmin. Wu Youmin had never experienced such grievances and immediately shouted:
"You are so presumptuous, are you so presumptuous? Do you know who I am? I am the nephew of the Queen of Heaven. Are you doing this to rebel?"
Yue Feng ignored his shouting and arrested the person. He immediately looked for traces of Qiangzi and the others in the yard behind the wine shop. After the three of Qiangzi were injured, they were all locked in the woodshed. Yue Feng kicked open the door of the woodshed. When Qiangzi saw Yue Feng, his eyes widened. He was so stunned that he could not speak for a while!
"What's wrong? Don't you recognize me? Let's go, the boy named Wu was caught by me!" Yue Feng said with a smile.
"Ah..." Qiangzi took a breath. He took a step forward and wanted to speak, but his eyes turned red first. He knelt on the ground with a "pop" and said, "I...I have implicated the leader..."
After he said this sentence, he started crying like a child. He never dreamed that Yue Feng would come to save him. The friendship between the two is not deep, and the trap that Qiangzi pokes is too big for anyone to contain, but...
The corners of Yue Feng's mouth raised slightly, his eyes glanced at the other two people, and said: "Stop talking nonsense! Wasn't Madam-in-law arrested? Why don't you go find someone quickly?"
As soon as Yue Feng said this, Qiangzi was shocked, kowtowed to Yue Feng again, and rushed out.
Yue Feng walked out of the backyard. At this time, Xiuchunfang was already surrounded by water. Almost all the people in the county who heard the news dared to come here.
Yue Feng clasped his fists and looked at the crowd and said: "On the orders of County Yamen Fu Zhubo and Zhou County Cheng, we arrested Wu Youmin, the thug who raped civilian girls. Dear fellow villagers, please do me a favor!"
As soon as Yue Feng said this, the crowd immediately burst into thunderous cheers, and someone shouted: "Well done, Fu Zhubo and Zhou Xiancheng are indeed upright officials!"
"Master Yue is also a good man and a true warrior of our Hegong County!"
The crowd was shouting, and Lu Xiaoshan squeezed in from behind and said in Yue Feng's ear: "Chief, Qiangzi didn't find his sister-in-law. It should be that someone named Wu had an entourage who greased the soles of his feet and took her away..."
